changes.comment: sdk-backend-tiger, sdk-ui-analytical-designer: Analytical Designer can show the live progress of the visualization's computation (cache check, query preparation, data source queries) in place of the loading spinner, and keeps the stats of the last load behind a "Live data" / "Saved result" link. Behind the `enableExecutionProgress` feature flag (prototype).

api-client-tiger: Regenerate the afm-rest-api client, adding the execution progress stream and the computation profile of the result metadata (exported from `endpoints/execution`). The AI workflow endpoints `cancelWorkflow`, `generateDashboardSummary` and `getWorkflowStatus` no longer exist in the backend, so their request and response types (`ActionsApiCancelWorkflowRequest`, `ActionsApiGenerateDashboardSummaryRequest`, `ActionsApiGetWorkflowStatusRequest`, `WorkflowDashboardSummaryRequestDto`, `WorkflowDashboardSummaryResponseDto`, `WorkflowStatusResponseDto`) are removed. This is a breaking change for callers of those endpoints.

sdk-ui-kit, sdk-ui-gen-ai: The animated "AI thinking" sparkle of the chat reasoning moved to sdk-ui-kit as the internal `UiAiThinkingIcon`, shared by the chat and the Analytical Designer loading view. It stays static under prefers-reduced-motion.
